lede: The biggest meeting of the week is TMVOA's first 2027 budget session on November 6, where the owners association takes its initial look at next year's spending and hears results from the completed 2025 audit — the kind of session that sets the tone for what Mountain Village property owners will be paying. On Sunday the 9th, San Miguel County convenes a cross-jurisdictional intergovernmental session with Telluride, Mountain Village, Ophir, and Norwood to compare notes on regional large projects and infrastructure pressures. Around the edges, the week offers a Financial Aid Workshop at the library Friday and a Free Legal Clinic Tuesday for anyone who needs either.

notable.stake: First look at TMVOA's 2027 draft budget and completed 2025 audit.
Quasi-judicial easement review and height variance vote for Mountain Village homes.
Regional large-projects update where development and infrastructure pressures across five jurisdictions surface.
